##### Project general facts

Cavalli Estates is a collection of magnificent six and seven-bedroom mansions located in the heart of a prestigious community, exuding bold expression and unmistakable opulence while showcasing the stunning trademarks of classic Cavalli at its fashionable best. Crafted for luxury connoisseurs who defy the boundaries of imagination, these exceptional residences feature built-in elevators, walk-in closets, private infinity pools, and the beach in your backyard. With expansive terraces overlooking stunning greens, each mansion offers statement views perfect for outdoor entertainment all year long.

The development offers an array of exclusive amenities including private infinity pools, private waterfalls, and naturally-lit basements opening up to courtyards that can be converted into cinema rooms, games arcades, home gyms, or wellness spots. Residents enjoy lush green spaces marrying stunning landscapes with beautiful blues of the water, ensuring the best of both worlds. The mansions come with generous parking spaces on basement and ground levels, ensuring convenience and security for residents and guests.

Each residence features semi-furnished units with walk-in closets and ensuite facilities, while kitchens are fully equipped with premium appliances for effortless culinary experiences. State-of-the-art bathrooms open up to private luxury spaces that showcase serenity in style, with chic sophistication throughout. Every detail has been carefully considered to create a harmonious and inviting home environment that reflects a commitment to luxury living.

##### Location description and benefits

This prestigious development is situated in a world-class self-contained community comprising villas, apartments, and a hotel, home to a renowned international golf club featuring a magnificent championship golf course and state-of-the-art facilities. The community features nearly four million square feet of parkland with various themed areas for leisure including sports fields, skate park, wave pool, petting farm, and dog park. Residents can enjoy food markets, outdoor movie nights, an activity-packed community centre, stables, and more, with everything needed right at home.

The community offers complete family care facilities and a reputed school, making it the perfect address for the entire family. Residents can play their favourite games at sports facilities or do weekly shopping at numerous supermarkets within the community. The area provides a world-class living experience where convenience and luxury seamlessly converge.

The location's strategic positioning ensures excellent connectivity to key destinations throughout Dubai, while the community's extensive amenities create a self-contained environment where everything is within reach. The area's thoughtful planning and family-oriented facilities promote well-being and an active lifestyle. This distinguished location represents the perfect combination of sporting excellence, family-friendly living, and community spirit, offering an unmatched lifestyle in one of Dubai's most prestigious master developments.
